claude.rationale: The analyzed entity was dissolved and deregistered on its August 31, 2016 emergence, with equity cancelled and the duty to file reports terminated by Form 15, and no periodic report was filed thereafter. As a result there is no audited financial statement, divestiture, or realized operating scalar attributable to the entity for the ~2019–2021 window, so no documented product/process disruption (p4) or process/organization fracture (p5) can be observed. Any successor operating results are explicitly noted as unverified and not attributable to the analyzed entity, so all pathway fields are coded uncertain (no public record).
